verdict.rationale: Qodo lets you manage its review automation as code through a .pr_agent.toml file at the repository, project, group, or organization level. Because that file lives in Git, versioning, PR-based review, and rollback come indirectly from the Git provider rather than from Qodo itself. The recommended portal Configurations page and the centralized rule system show no evidence of version history, change review, or rollback. missing for 10: native versioning/history of automation configs and rules, an explicit review/approval flow for config changes, documented rollback, versioning for portal-managed settings, independent corroboration.
